stem.text: The protein glutenin gives bread dough its elasticity. The diagram represents a polypeptide of glutenin.

stem.alt: Drawing of a coiled polypeptide chain with printed labels: tightly coiled region (at each end) and loose spiral.

stem.text: What describes the structure of glutenin?

A.text: quaternary structure because there are both globular and fibrous regions

B.text: quaternary structure because there are both spiral and tightly coiled regions

C.text: secondary structure because the loose spiral is an $\alpha$-helix

D.text: tertiary structure because the different regions form a 3D shape
